verdict.rationale: DBOS documents an official MCP server that agents or LLMs can connect to for tools that analyze and manage DBOS workflows, and a probe confirms the dedicated integration page. The evidence is only a brief description of it. Missing for 10: details of the specific tools exposed and the setup/transport configuration, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: You can use the DBOS Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to augment your LLM or agent with tools that can analyze and manage your DBOS workflows.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.dbos.dev/integrations/mcp
